Manage thumbnails per storage source, overriding the global settings:\n· Generation timing: when thumbnails are generated\n· Write back to server: whether thumbnails are saved back to the server

Generation timing:
Generate all: preload and batch-generate thumbnails while browsing (for NAS / unlimited servers).
After play: only load existing cache while browsing, then generate after playback exits —
 recommended for cloud drives to avoid frequent reads triggering rate limits.
Off: do not generate thumbnails.

Write back to server:
Write back on: save generated thumbnails/covers back to the .thumb/ / .cover/ directory.
Write back off: only generate locally, never write to the server.
Optional — if unset, follows the global “Save to server” switch.

Enter the lrcapi service address, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8080.
If the API requires an Authorization header, enter the token here. Leave empty if no authentication is needed.
After configuring an lrcapi service, NIplayer can fetch music metadata in the following scenarios:
1. When browsing folders, if an audio file has no embedded cover and there is no folder cover, it falls back to the API to fetch the cover.
2. When playing audio, it loads the lyric file in the same directory first; if none exists, it fetches lyrics via the API.
lrcapi is a self-hosted lyrics / cover metadata service. Tap the link below to learn how to set it up.
